supremeCourt.name: Tribunal Supremo de Justicia (TSJ)
supremeCourt.fspEraChanges: Widely documented capture: the 2004 Organic Law expanded the TSJ from 20 to 32 magistrates, giving the government a majority; in Dec 2015 the outgoing pro-government Assembly appointed 13 magistrates before the opposition majority was seated. The TSJ subsequently annulled or curtailed acts of the opposition-led National Assembly (2016–2017).
supremeCourt.stillServing: The court has remained PSUV-aligned ever since the 2004 expansion and 2015 packing; a 2022 reform cut it to 20 magistrates, re-appointed by the chavista-controlled National Assembly. No independent/opposition-appointed bloc remains.
